QuestInfo.name: [Alliance Mission] Expedition Mission - Erda Saturation
QuestInfo.1:
Striking the Luminous Giant with cannon fire will cause its Erda to spill out and form an Erda Saturation. Take advantage of that to eliminate monsters. When the mission is cleared, report back to #b#p3003564##k to complete the Expedition Mission.

The cannons can be charged #bfor a short time#k, #bimmediately after the Luminous Giant uses the Light of Annihilation#k. You have until it attacks again to charge the cannons. Gather Erda by eliminating monsters and charge the cannons as much as possible before they are attacked. You'll be able to fire more if #bmultiple people collect Erda to charge#k. The cannons will automatically fire once charged, dealing damage to the giant. This will cause the Erda within the giant to spill out, forming an #bErda Saturation for a short period of time#k.

#rThis mission is extremely difficult and dangerous. Be especially wary of the giant's Light of Annihilation and Light of Judgment attacks.#k
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated monsters during the Erda Saturation and completed the Expedition Mission.
